status_semantics.verified: endpoint identified, tested, data schema validated by live probes
status_semantics.candidate: listed by ESPN's enumeration, not yet probed
status_semantics.unavailable: probed and not exploitable through the scoreboard endpoint

classification_note: category/gender/zone are a derived editorial layer computed from ESPN names and slug tokens (see tools/build_registry.py). 'unspecified' means no explicit signal; nothing is guessed. This layer never feeds the decision engine.

collection_activation.semantics: New routes require a successful scoreboard schema probe. Previously active routes remain configured during temporary probe failures; actual collection status is reported separately in coverage.
